calculation: 13-week absolute change = p(t)-p(t-13 weeks); pct = 100*(p_t/p_tminus13-1); log_change_pct = 100*ln(p_t/p_tminus13). Values rounded from source prices, which are published to $0.001/gal.
availability_caveat: The EIA TWIP archive preserves the exact Monday observation date and price in a later-week Wednesday summary, after each Tuesday H14 cutoff. The pre-April-2025 historical schedule indicates a normal Monday ~5 p.m. ET release, but the later summary does not prove the exact values/bytes had been publicly posted by Tuesday or that no revision occurred in between. Treat historical availability as a schedule proxy under the listed assumptions only. strict_asof_qualified is false; historical_schedule_proxy is true. No original timestamped Monday GDFU capture or posting log was recovered. The publication schedule changed beginning week of April 7, 2025.
